verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.transliteration: Wat-Toor

translations.text: By the mount

verses.text_uthmani: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa kitaabim mastoor

translations.text: And [by] a Book inscribed

verses.text_uthmani: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fee raqqim manshoor

translations.text: In parchment spread open

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wal baitil ma'moor

translations.text: And [by] the frequented House

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.transliteration: Wassaqfil marfoo'

translations.text: And [by] the heaven raised high

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wal bahril masjoor

translations.text: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'

translations.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

verses.text_uthmani: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Maa lahoo min daafi'

translations.text: Of it there is no preventer.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa

translations.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
verses.transliteration: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa

translations.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen

translations.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon

translations.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

translations.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

verses.text_uthmani: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

translations.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

translations.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem

translations.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

verses.text_uthmani: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

translations.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een

translations.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

translations.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon

translations.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

verses.text_uthmani: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem

translations.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

translations.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

translations.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

translations.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.transliteration: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom

translations.text: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

translations.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.transliteration: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon

translations.text: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

translations.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

translations.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

translations.text: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

translations.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

verses.text_uthmani: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

translations.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

translations.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon

translations.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

translations.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

translations.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon

translations.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

translations.text: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon

translations.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

translations.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

translations.text: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

translations.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

translations.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

translations.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

translations.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.transliteration: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

translations.text: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.transliteration: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom

translations.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
